name: step_assert_metrics
description: Tests the assert_metrics step action for fps_min and frame_time_max_ms against known headless values (fps=60, frame_time=16ms).

steps.message: Assert fps_min only — headless delivers 60 fps, threshold 5.0.
Assert frame_time_max_ms only — headless delivers ~16ms, threshold 500ms.
Assert both fps_min and frame_time_max_ms together.
assert_metrics step action verified — all three forms passed.
